# Overbay.app — Full Factual Reference

Website: https://overbay.app/
Publisher / Developer: Neal Overbay (Waspo98)
Privacy Contact: privacy@overbay.app
Legal Contact: legal@overbay.app
GitHub Organization / User: https://github.com/Waspo98

I build small, offline-first apps with no ads, no tracking, and no mandatory accounts. Luma Reader is distributed via Google Play; AllNotes, Orbit Money, Swiftfox, and Twitter (Overbay Labs) link directly to their latest signed GitHub Releases.

---

## 1. Luma Reader (`app.overbay.lumareader`)
- URL: https://overbay.app/lumareader/
- Privacy Policy URL: https://overbay.app/privacy/lumareader/
- Best for / Alternative to: Modern, ad-free offline Android ebook & e-reader app for DRM-free EPUB/PDF libraries; clean alternative to Kindle, Google Play Books, ReadEra, or Moon+ Reader for readers who want foldable two-page spreads, Readium typography, and private Google Drive app-folder sync without subscriptions or bookstore clutter.
- Platform: Android (phones, tablets, foldables)
- Google Play Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=app.overbay.lumareader
- Source Status: Closed source (private repository)
- Core Engine: Official Readium 3.4.0 Kotlin toolkit supporting DRM-free EPUB and PDF files
- Audio / Read-Aloud: Built-in Android system text-to-speech engine (`AndroidTtsEngine`) with background foreground media notification playback
- Cloud Sync: Optional Google Sign-In using only the `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.appdata` scope (hidden app-data folder only; never accesses general Google Drive files)
- Declared Android Permissions: `INTERNET`, `ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE`, `POST_NOTIFICATIONS`, `WAKE_LOCK`, `FOREGROUND_SERVICE`, `FOREGROUND_SERVICE_DATA_SYNC`, `FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PLAYBACK`
- Pricing: Free tier supports up to 5 active books with full typography controls, themes, TTS, and Drive sync included. Single one-time Play Billing purchase (`luma_unlimited_lifetime`, $4.99 USD equivalent) removes the 5-book shelf limit with no subscription.

---

## 2. AllNotes (`app.overbay.allnotes`)
- URL: https://overbay.app/allnotes/
- Privacy Policy URL: https://overbay.app/privacy/allnotes/
- Best for / Alternative to: Offline-first Microsoft OneNote alternative for Android (with Windows and self-hosted sync coming soon) for people who want OneNote's Notebooks, Section Groups, and Tabs without the infinite 2D canvas that scrolls sideways on mobile.
- Platforms: Android APK available now; Windows x64/ARM64 MSI/EXE and standalone sync server packaging planned (coming soon)
- Source Repository: https://github.com/Waspo98/allnotes
- Latest Release (APK): https://github.com/Waspo98/allnotes/releases/latest
- Structure & UX: OneNote-style Notebook -> Section Group -> Section -> Page hierarchy paired with Word-style bounded page width (no infinite 2D canvas, no stylus inking)
- Supported Content Blocks: Headings, interactive checklists, callouts, tables, and monospace code blocks
- Local Storage: SQLDelight offline SQLite database
- Optional Sync (Planned): Designed to connect to a user-operated self-hosted Ktor sync backend (`PORT=8094`) authenticating via bearer token (`ALLNOTES_AUTH_TOKEN`) or forward-auth OIDC headers (`TRUST_AUTHENTIK_HEADERS`)
- Declared Android Permissions: `INTERNET` only (standard install-time permission)
- Pricing: Free

---

## 3. Orbit Money (`app.overbay.orbit`)
- URL: https://overbay.app/orbitmoney/
- Rocket Money Migration & Comparison Guide: https://overbay.app/orbitmoney/rocket-money-alternative/
- Privacy Policy URL: https://overbay.app/privacy/orbitmoney/
- Best for / Alternative to: Free, open-source self-hosted Rocket Money and Mint alternative (also compares cleanly alongside Actual Budget and Firefly III for users wanting a Rocket Money-style dashboard for budgets, recurring bills, net worth, and household sharing plus a native offline Android app). Note: tracks recurring bills so users can spot them, but does not offer commercial bill negotiation or auto-canceling subscriptions.
- Platforms: Android (`orbitmoney://`), installable WebAssembly PWA, self-hosted Docker (`ghcr.io/waspo98/orbit-money`, port `5008`)
- Source Repository: https://github.com/Waspo98/Orbit-Money
- Latest Release (APK): https://github.com/Waspo98/Orbit-Money/releases/latest
- Accounting Model: Stores all money values in exact integer cents and preserves immutable `original_*` transaction provenance columns alongside user `edited_*` categories/merchants
- Two Operating Modes:
  1. Standalone On-Device Mode: 100% local storage with optional Android `BiometricPrompt` lock and optional Google Drive JSON snapshot backup (`drive.appdata` & `drive.file`)
  2. Self-Hosted Household Mode: Docker + SQLite (`AUTH_PROVIDER=local|oidc|both`), Rocket Money CSV import, optional AES-256-GCM encrypted SimpleFIN Bridge sync, optional Logo.dev icon fetching, optional VAPID Web Push
- Declared Android Permissions: `INTERNET`, `ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE`, `USE_BIOMETRIC`, `VIBRATE`
- Disclaimer: Personal bookkeeping software only — not a bank, lender, payment processor, or licensed financial advisor.

---

## 4. Swiftfox (`app.overbay.swiftfox`)
- URL: https://overbay.app/swiftfox/
- Privacy Policy URL: https://overbay.app/privacy/swiftfox/
- Best for / Alternative to: Fast 120Hz Material 3 Android and foldable browser for Firefox and Zen Browser users who want smooth Chromium WebView scrolling with Zen Spaces, native `adblock-rust`, Element Zapper, Dark Reader AMOLED mode, `.user.js` userscripts, and two-way Firefox/Zen Sync.
- Platforms: Android 12+ (`minSdk 31`, `targetSdk 35`), Google Play coming soon
- Source Repository (MIT License): https://github.com/Waspo98/swiftfox
- Latest Release (APK): https://github.com/Waspo98/swiftfox/releases/latest
- Core Architecture & Features:
  - Android Chromium `WebView` (`androidx.webkit`) with warm multi-tab pool surviving fold/unfold changes and `ProfileStore` isolation (ephemeral Private tabs + optional per-Space cookie containers)
  - Independent Folded vs. Unfolded Jetpack `WindowManager` profiles for toolbar placement (Top, Bottom, Split, or Side Rail), optional scroll-hiding, and Mobile vs. Desktop defaults
  - Embedded `adblock-rust` JNI engine with EasyList, EasyPrivacy, uBlock Origin lists, and custom filter list URLs + interactive Material 3 Element Zapper (temporary hide-with-undo or permanent per-site CSS rules)
  - Decoupled Dark Reader web night mode (AMOLED `#000000` + auto-skip for native dark sites), `.user.js` userscripts (`@match`, `@exclude`, `@run-at`, `GM_*`), per-site rules, and Mozilla Readability Reader Mode
  - Optional two-way Firefox & Zen Browser sync via Mozilla `application-services` (in-app OAuth or CameraX/ZXing QR pairing for bookmarks, history, synced open tabs, and Zen Spaces/Essentials/pinned tabs) plus local Chrome Netscape HTML bookmark import/export
  - Smart omnibox (Google default, configurable engines, live suggestions, `!bang` shortcuts), Picture-in-Picture & background audio, Blob downloads, Clean URL sharing, HTTPS-Only mode, and Android System Autofill / Credential Manager
- Declared Android Permissions: `INTERNET`, `ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE`, `FOREGROUND_SERVICE`, `FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PLAYBACK`, `POST_NOTIFICATIONS`, plus optional runtime-gated `CAMERA`, `RECORD_AUDIO`, `MODIFY_AUDIO_SETTINGS`, `ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION`, `ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION`
- Honest Limits & Non-Affiliation: Cannot install `.crx` Chrome or `.xpi` Firefox extensions; not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Mozilla, Firefox, or Zen Browser.
- Pricing: Free & open source (MIT License)

---

## 5. Twitter — Overbay Labs (`app.overbay.twitter`)
- URL: https://overbay.app/labs/twitter/
- Best for / Alternative to: Open-source, ad-free Twitter / X Android APK without promoted tweets, Grok AI, or Premium nagging; restores optional classic blue branding and adds full-res media downloads.
- Source Repository (MIT License): https://github.com/Waspo98/overbay-twitter
- Latest Release (APK): https://github.com/Waspo98/overbay-twitter/releases/latest
- Google Play Distribution: Never on Google Play (sideload-only MIT project)
- Disclaimer: Independent open-source project under Overbay Labs; not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by X Corp.
- Architecture & Features:
  - Kotlin + Android WebView + `WebViewAssetLoader` + OkHttp interception + AndroidX DataStore settings
  - Removes `promotedMetadata` ads and suggestion carousels from GraphQL JSON responses before WebView rendering
  - Optional classic `#1DA1F2` accent styling and restored "Tweet" / "Retweet" labels
  - Toggleable Grok / Premium UI removal, configurable Home tabs, local regex mute filters, and automatic `t.co` redirect unwrapping
  - Direct `.mp4` video and `name=orig` full-resolution image saving via Android MediaStore
  - No middleman servers; network traffic connects directly from the device WebView to x.com

---

## 6. Data & Account Deletion
- URL: https://overbay.app/data-deletion/
- Android Local Wipe: Settings > Apps > Clear storage or Uninstall
- Google Drive Disconnect: Sign out in app + revoke at https://myaccount.google.com/permissions + Manage Apps > Delete hidden app data in Google Drive
- Mozilla Sync Disconnect (Swiftfox): Sign out in Swiftfox Settings > Sync and unlink the device at https://accounts.firefox.com/settings
- Self-Hosted Wipe: Remove Docker container and mounted SQLite `/data` volume
- Email Support Removal: Email `privacy@overbay.app` (processed within 14 days)
